taxon.wikipedia_summary: Vinca difformis, commonly called the Intermediate Periwinkle, is an evergreen, flowering subshrub native to Western Europe, including the Iberian Peninsula, France, the Italian Peninsula and Sardinia. Its whitish-blue flowers have a blooming season from late winter to early spring. It grows to about half a meter, and forms mats over a meter across.

page.title: Vinca difformis
page.extract:
Vinca difformis, commonly called the intermediate periwinkle, is an evergreen, flowering subshrub.
It grows to about 0.5 metres (1+1⁄2 ft) tall, and forms mats over 1 m (3+1⁄2 ft) across. Its whitish-blue flowers have a blooming season from late winter to early spring.
It is native to Western Europe, including the Iberian Peninsula, France, the Italian Peninsula and Sardinia.
